headline: Weathered Expanse Tilts Colonial as Casualty Rolls Mount
war_summary: The three hours since our last edition have redrawn the balance in the Weathered Expanse, where five strongholds now stand under Colonial colors against four Warden works, reversing the Warden-leaning count previously reported, even as losses there pass a thousand men an hour to each army and still climb. Fishermans Row, flag-still at our previous filing, has stirred anew: its register reads eight Colonial posts to one Warden, with the ruined work rebuilt under the Colonial banner. Stlican Shelf is the liveliest field, its last flag logged at half past five, fourteen events at Thornhold alone in the day, and hourly losses accelerating past four hundred Colonial and five hundred Warden beneath a six-to-three Warden count. The Linn of Mercy holds at ten Colonial works to one, its Lathair ground quiet on flags since mid-afternoon, though the Warden toll there runs nearly twice the Colonial. Mooring County's markers have not shifted since late morning, yet casualties run near five hundred the hour on either side. Callahans Passage and the Nevish Line, without flag events, likewise bleed heavily. Day 290 of the war; no victor declared, thirty-four victory towns required.
